description: Use this when the person describes a logo from parts, such as a phone with a chat symbol, or wants a graphic, lettering or placement a ready made design can't change. Only graphics in Webba's library are used, and no new artwork is generated: if none matches, it says so and names the closest. Do not use this when the person just wants logo ideas for a business, which is find_designs, or to choose or download a design already shown: pass that design's state to get_download.

business_name.description: The business name, up to 22 characters.

font.description: A style such as 'modern', or a font id.

from_state.description: The ready made design this replaces, to keep its colours and tagline.

graphic.description: The graphic the person described, such as 'smartphone with chat' or 'delivery van with stacked boxes'.

tagline.description: A tagline only if the person gave one.

name: start_build
title: Build a logo from parts
